title: Euro trades with caution against US Dollar ahead of Fed’s policy meeting
summary: The Euro (EUR) trades subduedly at around 1.1535 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday. The major currency pair trades cautiously ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.

title: Euro: Recovery does not justify stronger EUR – BNY
